name: create signed URL for IDL object download
parse signedUrl to response
configure file-path
Signed URL with path parameter in GET request
info:
This flow creates the signedURL for an object located in IDL. 
It needs to get the 'imgPath' parameter via the URL. 
This should be the full path to the object in the data lake.

- Flow builds Body for IDL API call 
- POST this request to the generate Download URL endpoint
- parses the received signedURL as output for further processing

In this example, the image is passed to Dashboard Designer for visualization. 
Using this, you can pass an image-path variable from Dashboard Designer dynamically to this flow and then view the image in Dashboard Designer.
